title: Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning
best_for_zh: 关于离策略、在策略学习与多阶段语言模型后训练的统一框架。
one_line: A 2026 framework that maps post-training by who supplied the trajectory and which behavioral bottleneck a stage addresses.
一篇按轨迹来源和行为瓶颈重新组织后训练方法的 2026 综述。
why: It makes trajectory provenance and stage composition visible audit questions instead of treating post-training labels as interchangeable.
inclusion_reason: A 2026 routing primer for separating externally supplied supervision from learner-generated rollouts before readers compare SFT, preference optimization, process supervision, verifier guidance, distillation, and RL.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Post-training is commonly named after objectives—SFT, preference optimization, RL, or distillation—without first asking where the trajectories come from or which behavioral bottleneck a stage changes. The primary source is the 2026 arXiv preprint at https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07941. It asks how to view supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, process supervision, verifier-guided methods, distillation, and multi-stage pipelines in one framework.

Its decision boundary is conceptual routing, not a new data release or optimizer. The central data surface is a trajectory: either externally supplied for off-policy learning or produced by the learner for on-policy learning. That distinction matters because a supplied trace needs source and annotation details, while a rollout needs generation policy, budget, filtering, and verifier or reward details. The official arXiv record and complete local bilingual Card make this ready as background material.

后训练常按 SFT、偏好优化、RL 或蒸馏等目标命名，却容易忽略轨迹来源和每个阶段改变的行为瓶颈。这篇 2026 年 arXiv 预印本提出一个框架来理解监督微调、偏好优化、强化学习、过程监督、验证器引导方法、蒸馏和多阶段流程之间的关系。

它的决策边界是概念框架，而不是发布新数据集或新优化器。核心数据面是 轨迹：离策略 学习使用外部供给轨迹，在策略 学习使用学习策略生成的 展开轨迹。这个区别决定了需要记录的信息：外部轨迹需要来源和标注，展开轨迹需要生成策略、预算、过滤和 验证器或 奖励。官方 arXiv 记录与完整双语 卡片 足以支持其作为背景材料收录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper first separates post-training by trajectory provenance: off-policy learning consumes externally supplied trajectories, while on-policy learning uses rollouts generated by the learner. It then gives three behavioral roles. Support expansion makes useful behavior reachable; policy reshaping improves behavior in already reachable regions; behavioral consolidation preserves, transfers, or amortizes useful behavior across stages and model transitions.

This is a taxonomy for reasoning-data work because a label such as “SFT” does not determine either provenance or effect: the same objective can expand support or reshape a policy. The paper treats preference optimization as commonly off-policy reshaping, recognizes that online variants approach learner-generated states, and frames distillation as consolidation rather than merely compression. Closest comparisons are broad post-training surveys and specialized preference or reasoning surveys; this Card uses the paper for the provenance-and-stage lens.

论文先按 轨迹 来源 区分后训练：离策略 学习消费外部供给轨迹，在策略 学习使用学习者生成的 展开轨迹。随后提出三个行为角色：support expansion 让有用行为变得可达；policy reshaping 改善已经可达区域中的行为；behavioral consolidation 在阶段和模型迁移之间保存、转移或摊销有用行为。

这是一套 推理数据分类框架，因为“SFT”这样的标签既不能决定数据来源，也不能决定行为作用。同一目标既可能扩展支持集，也可能重塑策略。论文把偏好优化通常理解为 离策略 reshaping，同时指出在线变体会接近学习者生成状态；并把蒸馏理解为 consolidation，而不只是压缩。最接近的是宽泛后训练综述及偏好/推理专门综述，本 卡片 采用其“来源—阶段”视角。

title: Method
方法
html:
This is a literature framework, not a training recipe. Its inputs are published descriptions of post-training methods and their trajectories. The pipeline first classifies trajectory provenance, then interprets a method as support expansion, policy reshaping, behavioral consolidation, or a coordinated combination. The output is a way to diagnose a behavioral bottleneck and reason about composition across stages.

The paper surveys rewards, preferences, process signals, verifiers, and RL, but it does not release a universal reward, judge, environment, dataset, or code artifact. Reuse therefore means applying its questions to a primary release: record whether the traces are supplied or generated; preserve the role of any reward/verifier/judge; and capture rollout sampling, filtering, and transition between stages. Reproducibility evidence—splits, data licenses, contamination checks, and model budgets—must be recovered from the cited primary source.

这是一套文献框架，不是训练配方。输入是已发表的后训练方法及其轨迹描述；流程先分类轨迹来源，再把方法解释为 support expansion、policy reshaping、behavioral consolidation 或它们的组合；输出是诊断行为瓶颈和理解跨阶段组合的方法。

论文讨论 奖励、偏好、过程信号、验证器与 RL，但不发布通用 奖励、裁判模型、环境、数据集或代码 发布产物。因此复用时应回到一手发布：记录轨迹是供给还是生成，保留每个 奖励/验证器/裁判模型的角色，并捕捉 展开轨迹采样、过滤及阶段之间的转换。划分、许可证、污染检查和模型预算等可复现性证据只能从被引的原始工作中获得。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official abstract explicitly identifies two regimes based on trajectory provenance and three recurring behavioral roles. It also lists the covered post-training families and reports a 38-page paper with one figure and eight tables on arXiv. Those details substantiate the scope of the survey, not the reliability of every cited data source or training claim.
官方摘要明确给出按 轨迹 来源 划分的两种学习范式，以及三个反复出现的行为角色；arXiv 记录还标注该文为 38 页、1 图、8 表。这些证据说明了综述的覆盖范围，并不自动证明每一篇被引论文的数据来源或训练结论都可靠。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier accounts often organize post-training by an objective name or a historical lineage. This paper changes the comparison axis to trajectory provenance and behavioral intervention, making it possible to say why the same named objective has different audit needs in different stages. Its direction signal is the claim that coordinated systems design and stage composition increasingly matter alongside single-objective improvements.

Off-policy learning, on-policy RL, SFT, preference optimization, and distillation are not introduced by this paper. Nor does it establish a new benchmark or dataset. Before reusing the framework, inspect whether a concrete pipeline truly has a stable provenance boundary: online preference collection, teacher-guided rollouts, and replay buffers can mix regimes. As an arXiv preprint, it has no confirmed archival venue.

较早的后训练叙述常按目标名称或历史 脉络 组织。本文把比较轴换成 轨迹 来源 与行为干预，使读者能解释为何同名目标在不同阶段有不同审计要求。它的方向信号是：除单一目标改进外，协调的系统设计和阶段组合正在变得更重要。

Off-policy 学习、在策略 RL、SFT、偏好优化和蒸馏都不是本文首创，它也没有建立新 基准或数据集。复用框架前，应检查具体 流程是否真的存在稳定的来源边界：在线偏好收集、教师引导 展开轨迹和 replay buffer 可能混合两类范式。该工作仍是 arXiv 预印本，尚无可确认的正式发表 venue。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The framework is deliberately high level. Hybrid pipelines can contain supplied demonstrations, generated rollouts, and learned filtering in one loop, so a binary provenance label can conceal important transitions. It also cannot replace source-level evidence about annotations, licenses, split construction, or contamination.
该框架刻意保持高层次。混合 流程可在同一循环中同时包含供给示范、生成 展开轨迹和学习得到的过滤器，二元来源标签可能掩盖关键转换。它也不能替代关于标注、许可证、划分 构建或污染的一手证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The paper presents a unified account of off-policy and on-policy LLM post-training. It distinguishes externally supplied trajectories from learner-generated rollouts and relates them to support expansion, policy reshaping, and behavioral consolidation. The framework describes how demonstrations, preference data, verifier signals, and reinforcement learning can occupy different stages of one post-training pipeline.
论文提出离策略与在策略 LLM 后训练的统一表述。它区分外部供给的轨迹和学习者生成的 展开轨迹，并将它们与支持扩展、策略重塑和行为巩固联系起来。该框架描述 示范、偏好 数据、验证器信号和强化学习如何处在同一后训练管线的不同阶段。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Post-training methods differ not only by algorithm name, but by who produced the trajectories and which states the model learns from. The off-policy/on-policy distinction reveals when a system relies on existing data and when it continues learning from experience it generated itself.
后训练方法的差别不只在算法名称，更在于轨迹由谁生成、模型从哪些状态中学习。离策略与在策略的区分，揭示了系统何时依赖已有数据，何时开始从自身生成的经验中继续学习。
